name: Seo Audit
summary: An SEO agent skill for quick, lightweight, default single-page SEO audits. Performs basic on-page and site-level checks and outputs a structured basic SEO audit report. Use when the user asks for "SEO audit", "SEO check", "check my page SEO", "page analysis", or wants a first-pass review of a URL. If the user requests "deep audit", "full report", "technical SEO audit", or "advanced SEO", use seo-audit-full instead.

name: Seo Audit Full
summary: Advanced full SEO audit skill. Runs its own full workflow from local scripts, including the basic SEO checks plus PageSpeed, social metadata, and advanced review modules when available.
